summary.text: Stephanie Yocum is the Democratic candidate for the Indiana House of Representatives, District 88, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican incumbent Chris Jeter.
A nonprofit executive, she lists public education, affordability and local decision-making among her priorities.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Yocum was born in Marion, Indiana, graduated from Marion High School, and earned a bachelor's degree from Hanover College in 2003.
Her career experience includes working as a nonprofit executive.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked in leadership positions for education and healthcare organizations for the last 20 years.
Yocum advanced from the Democratic primary for District 88 on May 5, 2026.
In her survey, she said she would work to fully fund public schools, support and retain teachers, and ensure transparency in how education dollars are spent.
She also said she would work to expand access to affordable child care, support housing solutions, and restore decision-making authority to local governments.
